note: Illustrative page with an apply control, captured four weeks before the run date. Not captured from any real posting.
bodyText: Machine Learning Engineer (illustrative posting). About the team: we build the models that rank, recommend and moderate content for millions of people. What you will do: train and evaluate models in Python and PyTorch, ship them behind feature flags, and measure their effect with online experiments. What we look for: a degree in computer science or a related field, coursework or projects in machine learning, and comfort with SQL and cloud tooling.
